method.label: Prove a bound and attain it

annotationRationale: The solution proves a universal lower bound on the number of terms and constructs an allowed sum attaining that bound.
sourceMethod: Follows the official argument using the maximum two-digit number 99, then the construction with twenty 99s and one 44.

review.mathCheck: Any sum of at most 20 two-digit numbers is at most \(20\cdot99=1980<2024\). The construction \(2024=20\cdot99+44\) uses 21 permitted terms, so the minimum is 21, choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Attached AMC 12A solution #3 uses the same maximum-term bound and construction. The candidate faithfully adapts it in original wording and explicitly establishes both the lower bound and attainability.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed extremal concept matches both essential steps. Repetition is permitted, and the final term 44 satisfies the two-digit restriction.
